install_order_rationale: Dataview must load first (provides index API). Blueprint and Breadcrumbs depend on index. QuickAdd depends on Templates folder. Excalidraw and Meta-Bind are independent. Load order: Dataview → Breadcrumbs → Blueprint → QuickAdd → Meta-Bind → Excalidraw → Search (core, always available).

plugins.name: Dataview
plugins.faerie_purpose: Powers dashboard queries (mission manifest tables, agent output feeds, quality score heatmaps). Core dependency for all table views in 00-SHARED/Dashboards/.

validation.test_query:
```dataview
TABLE file.name, status FROM "10-Investigations" SORT file.mtime DESC LIMIT 5
```
validation.expected_result: Table renders with file names and status fields — no 'Dataview: failed to query' error
validation.pass_criteria: Table appears with ≥0 rows and no error message in 5 seconds

plugins.fallback_if_disabled: Static markdown tables replace dynamic Dataview tables. Dashboard functionality degrades gracefully.

plugins.name: Breadcrumbs
plugins.faerie_purpose: Compass-edge navigation. Reads north/south/east/west frontmatter fields and renders breadcrumb trail + prev/next navigation. Enables human navigation of mission-graph DAG without needing to know file paths.

validation.test_query: Open any file with `north: [[some-file]]` frontmatter — breadcrumb trail must appear at top of document showing hierarchy
validation.expected_result: Breadcrumb trail visible: 'parent > current > child'. Prev/Next buttons functional. Clicking a breadcrumb level navigates to that file.
validation.pass_criteria: Trail visible in both edit and preview mode; prev/next navigate correctly

known_conflicts.issue: Both attempt to render edge relationships; duplicate edge rendering in some graph views
known_conflicts.resolution: Disable Excalibrain's 'show hierarchical edges' option to let Breadcrumbs own that layer

plugins.fallback_if_disabled: Manual wikilink navigation only. Mission-graph traversal requires knowing file names.

plugins.name: Blueprint
plugins.faerie_purpose: Agent output formatting templates. Agents write manifests; Blueprint defines how they render in the vault. Blueprint files in Blueprints/ folder define structured note layouts for investigation entities, mission nodes, findings.

validation.test_query: Open Blueprints/ folder — blueprint files (.blueprint or .md with blueprint frontmatter) must be listed. Create a new note from a Blueprint via command palette.
validation.expected_result: Command palette shows 'Blueprint: Create from...' command. Selecting a blueprint creates a new note with pre-filled frontmatter.
validation.pass_criteria: Blueprint note created in correct folder with correct frontmatter template applied

known_conflicts.issue: Linter may reformat Blueprint-generated frontmatter; can corrupt structured fields
known_conflicts.resolution: Add Blueprint-generated files to Linter exclusion list, or disable frontmatter linting rules

plugins.fallback_if_disabled: Manual frontmatter entry. QuickAdd templates partially compensate.

plugins.name: QuickAdd
plugins.faerie_purpose: Injects standardized frontmatter on note creation; routes new notes to correct folders; provides mission_choice daily note template. Daily template carries mission_choice field that agents use for routing.

validation.test_query: Cmd/Ctrl+P → 'QuickAdd: Daily Note' — new file should open in 00-Inbox with today's date and mission_choice frontmatter field present
validation.expected_result: New file created at 00-Inbox/YYYY-MM-DD-daily.md with type, status, tags, created, updated, mission_choice frontmatter
validation.pass_criteria: File created, frontmatter complete, mission_choice field present (even if empty)

plugins.fallback_if_disabled: Manual frontmatter entry on every new note. Daily templates not automatically applied.

plugins.name: Excalidraw
plugins.faerie_purpose: Visual mission graph diagrams. Agents or humans can draw mission-graph topology, entity relationship diagrams, and investigation timelines as Excalidraw files embedded in vault notes.

validation.test_query: Cmd/Ctrl+P → 'Excalidraw: Create new drawing' — Excalidraw canvas must open in the Excalidraw/ folder
validation.expected_result: Canvas opens, drawing tools available. Embedding in a note via ![[drawing.excalidraw]] renders inline.
validation.pass_criteria: Drawing created, embeddable in notes, renders in preview

known_conflicts.issue: See Breadcrumbs entry — edge rendering overlap in graph view

plugins.fallback_if_disabled: Static PNG/SVG diagrams only. No interactive canvas.

plugins.name: Search (Obsidian Core)
plugins.faerie_purpose: Full-text and frontmatter search across all vault notes. Critical for finding specific agent outputs by task_id, mission, or bearing without needing to know the file path.

validation.test_query: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F → search for 'mission:vault-infrastructure-overhaul' — should return relevant notes
validation.expected_result: Search results panel shows notes with matching frontmatter field values
validation.pass_criteria: At least 1 result when searching for known frontmatter values

plugins.fallback_if_disabled: Core plugin — always available in Obsidian

plugins.name: Juggl
plugins.purpose: Interactive graph visualization for mission graph exploration

plugins.name: Linter
plugins.purpose: Enforces frontmatter schema + consistent note formatting

breadcrumbs_x_excalibrain.symptom: Duplicate edge lines in graph view
breadcrumbs_x_excalibrain.resolution: Disable Excalibrain hierarchical edges; keep Breadcrumbs as navigation layer

blueprint_x_linter.symptom: Linter may rewrite Blueprint frontmatter ordering, breaking structured fields
blueprint_x_linter.resolution: Add Blueprint-generated files to Linter exclusion list
